verdict.rationale: Deel's REST API and MCP tools (listOfContracts, worker/payroll endpoints) let a user pull core data out in JSON, an open format, so some export capability exists. However there is no first-party documentation of a comprehensive 'export all my data' feature, account closure/data-portability tooling, and community feedback (deel-comm-1) describes friction and lost trust when trying to leave the platform. missing for 10: explicit full-account data export or GDPR-style portability feature, documented account closure process, independent confirmation that a full data dump is actually achievable in practice.
